scope: Explicit native render-pipeline initialization readiness. No attribution or elimination claim for historical 333/340 ms GPU stalls; no FPS claim.

change.native: Create render pipelines through createRenderPipelineAsync when that API is available, preserving every descriptor. Launch material variants in parallel; await the probe-filter pipeline before creating its 42 automatic-layout bindings; resolve scalar, map and surface-pass handles before publishing the renderer.
change.fallback: Use synchronous render-pipeline creation only when the async API is unavailable. Preserve labelled validation errors and original GPUPipelineError causes; do not retry an async failure synchronously. Destroy the failed device once, including when error-scope collection rejects.
change.unhandledRejectionBoundary: Attach immediate rejection handlers to pending render pipelines and fallback validation-scope promises until the final graph join. A CPU mocked control reproduced one unhandled fallback-scope rejection in the validated candidate and zero in production while shader diagnostics waited across an event turn.
change.unchanged: Render descriptors, shader math, quality, visibility, compute-pipeline creation, interactive render/history behavior and frame budgets.

validation.focusedCommand: node --test test/render-pipeline-readiness.test.mjs test/renderer-post.test.mjs test/gpu-visibility.test.mjs test/render-surface-presence.test.mjs test/gpu-batch-key-lifetime.test.mjs test/temporal-batch-updates.test.mjs
validation.descriptorOracleScope: Full WGSL and explicit layout/render descriptor hashes frozen from the preceding synchronous production source; 101 canonical GPU descriptors and 74 minimal CPU descriptors match both async and capability-fallback initialization.
validation.sourceParity: Production exactly matches the native-validated ignored candidate after restoring imports and adding only immediate fallback-scope rejection handling. The corrected candidate independently compiled to the exact production dist renderer, excluding the source-map trailer.

nativePostAdoption.preservation: The preceding report/image and initial failed attempt remain archived under artifacts/render-stability/async-pipeline/post-adoption/. The first attempt failed before renderer initialization because the existing harness polled document.documentElement.dataset while documentElement was temporarily null after navigation; rerunning the unchanged harness passed. No production or harness source was modified for the run.
nativePostAdoption.limits: Native rendering correctness only. Root semantic tests ran concurrently, so these timings are not performance evidence. All browser sessions closed and their unique temporary profiles were cleaned up.

nativeCandidateProbe.limits: Two startup observations per variant. Driver-cache state is uncontrolled; a fresh profile does not prove a cold driver cache. Queue completion deliberately serializes probe frames. The small scene uses only a subset of the 101 initialized render pipelines. Host completion includes costs outside GPU timestamp intervals and is not a pipeline-only measurement. Native runs validated the preceding ignored candidate; production retains the exact async branch plus the separately tested fallback rejection handler.
